leads.title: Bostock v. Clayton County - U.S. Supreme Court
leads.documents: Establishes that workplace discrimination on basis of sexual orientation or gender identity is sex discrimination under Title VII, providing federal employment protection for LGBTQ people in West Virginia where state statutes do not address it.
leads.detail: Cited as decided June 15, 2020, consolidated with Altitude Express, Inc. v. Zarda and R.G. & G.R. Harris Funeral Homes Inc. v. EEOC; no URL visible in text.

leads.title: West Virginia House Bill 3293 - Relating to single-sex participation in interscholastic athletic events
leads.documents: State law restricting transgender athletes from teams aligning with gender identity, defining male/female based solely on reproductive biology and genetics at birth; signed by Gov. Jim Justice, effective July 1, 2021.
leads.detail: Cited as passed March 2021, signed by Governor Jim Justice; no URL visible in text.

leads.title: West Virginia v. B. P. J. - U.S. Supreme Court / Fourth Circuit Court of Appeals
leads.documents: Challenge to WV transgender sports ban; Fourth Circuit held in April 2024 law barring transgender girls/women from girls/women's teams is unconstitutional; Supreme Court agreed to hear case in July 2025.
leads.detail: Cited with Federal Judge Joseph Goodwin Jan 5, 2023 ruling upholding bill and April 2023 Supreme Court declination, followed by April 2024 Fourth Circuit reversal; no URL visible in text.

leads.title: Riley Gaines Act - West Virginia Legislature (March 2025)
leads.documents: Comprehensive enacted law that only recognizes male and female and does not recognize transgender nor non-binary persons for legal purposes.
leads.detail: Cited as newly enacted and implemented March 2025 legislation signed by Governor Morrisey, amended to remove genital-examination language; no URL visible in text.

leads.title: West Virginia ban on gender-affirming care for minors - West Virginia Legislature
leads.documents: Bans puberty blockers, hormone therapy, and surgery for transgender minors except severe dysphoria diagnosed by at least two physicians; signed by Governor, effective Jan 1, 2024.
leads.detail: Cited as passed March 2023 after February 2023 House of Delegates hearing; no URL visible in text.

leads.title: Anderson v. Crouch - U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit
leads.documents: Lawsuit challenging state Medicaid program's exclusion of gender-affirming care for trans adults; documents Medicaid coverage machinery for trans healthcare.
leads.detail: Cited as argued Dec 9, 2025; related to August 2022 court ruling that 1997 Medicaid ban on sexual reassignment surgery was unconstitutional, noted as overturned in 2026 by 4th Circuit; no URL visible in text.

leads.title: 2023 religious refusal bill - West Virginia Legislature / Governor
leads.documents: Allows businesses and companies to legally refuse to cater to LGBTQ customers with qualified immunity; documents enforcement risk for LGBTQ visitors in public accommodations.
leads.detail: Cited as passed March 2023 and signed by Governor effective immediately; no URL visible in text.

leads.title: Ordinance nullification bill - West Virginia Senate
leads.documents: Would nullify all city and county ordinances that prevented discrimination against LGBTQ individuals, removing local employment/housing/public-accommodations protections.
leads.detail: Cited as passed Senate March 2025 by vote 25-8, awaiting House of Delegates vote; cities listed as Athens, Beckley, Charleston, Huntington, Morgantown, Wheeling and others; no URL visible in text.

leads.title: McGee v. Cole - U.S. District Court (Lambda Legal)
leads.documents: Federal lawsuit challenging denial of marriage licenses to same-sex couples, leading to legalization of same-sex marriage in WV Oct 9, 2014 after AG Patrick Morrisey stopped defending ban.
leads.detail: Cited as filed Oct 1, 2013 by Lambda Legal, assigned to U.S. District Judge Robert C. Chambers, stayed June 10, 2014 pending Bostic v. Schaefer in Fourth Circuit; no URL visible in text.

leads.title: West Virginia's Equality Profile - via the Movement Advancement Project
leads.documents: Institutional equality profile summarizing LGBTQ legal status and rights machinery in West Virginia.
leads.detail: Listed under External links as: West Virginia's Equality Profile - via the Movement Advancement Project; no URL visible in text. Companion link: LGBT Rights in West Virginia - via Equaldex.
